STAGE.open: An NCR that is {stage} does not move there.
STAGE.frozen: The NCR is {stage}: it never changes.

ACTION_DONE.open: No containment action is done yet: do one first (hold the stock, check the work in progress …).

NO_OPEN_ACTION.ok: No containment action is still open.
NO_OPEN_ACTION.open_one: {count} containment action is still open: do it or cancel it first.
NO_OPEN_ACTION.open_other: {count} containment actions are still open: do or cancel them first.

ALL_DECIDED.open: {decided} of {affected} {unit} decided · {left} left: decide the rest first.

APPROVED.open_one: {count} decision waits for another person's approval.
APPROVED.open_other: {count} decisions wait for another person's approval.
APPROVED.openSome: A decision waits for another person's approval.

CARRIED_OUT.open_one: {count} decision waits for its stock move or follow-up record: carry it out first.
CARRIED_OUT.open_other: {count} decisions wait for their stock move or follow-up record: carry them out first.

HOLDS.none: No hold of this NCR is still active.
HOLDS.some_one: {count} hold this NCR decides is closed with it.
HOLDS.some_other: {count} holds this NCR decides are closed with it.

NOTHING_CARRIED_OUT.open_one: {count} decision is carried out: close the NCR instead.
NOTHING_CARRIED_OUT.open_other: {count} decisions are carried out: close the NCR instead.

board.label: Nonconformances · board

held.back: An NCR never goes back a stage.
held.skip: An NCR moves one stage at a time: next is {stage}.
held.noClose: Closing an NCR needs the right to close NCRs (quality.ncr.close).
held.noManage: Moving an NCR needs the right to follow NCRs up (quality.ncr.manage).
held.readOnly: Your role may look at the board, not move cards (quality.ncr.manage).
held.offline: Offline: moves wait until the connection is back.

board.keyDrag: Drag a card onto another stage
board.keyDrop: Put it down there (on Closed, the closing signature opens), or open a card not picked up
board.keyCancel: Put it back where it was

held.frozen: The NCR is {stage}: it never changes.
held.editDecided: The NCR is decided: its problem is read-only now.
held.notReady: Not every check is met yet.
held.contained: The containment is done: actions change while the NCR is open.
held.containFirst: Contain it first: its containment actions done.
held.cancelCarried: A decision is carried out: close the NCR instead.
held.cancelDecided: A decided NCR is closed, not cancelled.
held.noManage: Your role does not follow NCRs up (quality.ncr.manage).
held.noRaise: Your role does not raise NCRs (quality.ncr.raise).
held.noClose: Your role does not close NCRs (quality.ncr.close).
held.noPeople: Your role cannot list people to name (tasks.manage).

decision.noApprove: Your role does not approve NCR decisions (quality.ncr.approve).
decision.ownDecision: You decided this: another person approves it (four eyes).
decision.waiting: This decision waits for another person's approval first.
decision.noMove: This stock move needs {permission} at the NCR's site.
decision.noRework: A rework order needs the right to rework (production.rework).
decision.noClaims: A supplier claim needs the right to manage claims (purchasing.claims.manage).
decision.decidedStage: The NCR is decided: its decisions are carried out, no longer changed.
decision.approvedFrozen: An approved decision is not changed: remove it before it is carried out, or carry it out.
decision.allDecided: The whole quantity is decided: change or remove a decision first.

problem.signedOut: Your session ended. Sign in again.
problem.forbidden: Your role does not allow this.
problem.stepUp: This needs a fresh code from your authenticator app.
problem.notFound: It is not there any more, or it belongs to another company.
problem.refused: The factory refused it as it stands.
problem.invalid: It was refused as it is: check the fields.
problem.rateLimited: Too many tries. Wait a minute.
problem.contract: The answer was not what this page expects. Reload the page.
problem.unavailable: The factory service did not answer. Try again in a moment.
problem.internal: Something went wrong on our side. Try again.
problem.stale: Someone changed this NCR meanwhile: it has been read again. Check it and do it once more.
problem.checks: Not yet: a check is not met.

close.title: Close {number}
close.readFailed: The NCR could not be read: close this and try again.
close.signBody: You sign that every quantity of {number} has its outcome and that its decisions are carried out. The holds it decides close with it. A closed NCR never changes.
close.noteHint: What was done and why it is finished (at least 3 characters).
close.stepUpNext: Your authenticator app's code is asked when you close (the e-signature).
close.heldReading: The checklist is still being read.
close.heldChecks: The checklist is not complete: see what is missing above.
close.stepUp: Closing an NCR is an e-signature: confirm it with a fresh code.
close.doneHolds_one: {number} is closed; {count} hold closed with it.
close.doneHolds_other: {number} is closed; {count} holds closed with it.
close.cancelled: Nothing was closed: the code was not given.

list.intro: Every nonconformance of your sites, raised from an inspection, a bundle, a lot, a complaint, a return or by hand.
list.countMax: The newest {count} NCRs (narrow the rows to see older ones)
list.failed: The NCRs could not be read
list.emptyBody: They are raised from inspections, bundles, complaints, returns or by hand.
list.noMatchBody: Clear the filters to see every open NCR.
list.noAccessBody: Nonconformances need the right to see NCRs (quality.ncr.view). The owner or an administrator grants it in Admin › Roles & permissions.
list.heldAssignNone: None of the NCRs picked is still open.
list.foot: A row opens the NCR. Pick rows to assign an owner or export them.
list.boardFoot: The board shows the same rows by stage; Closed shows the last 30 days.

hint.open: Open, contained or decided: not closed yet.
hint.containmentOverdue: Open past the containment due time, or an action past its own.
hint.closedThisMonth: Counts this month's closures; pressed, it shows every closed NCR, newest first.

new.intro: Say what is wrong. The factory gives the number when you create it.
new.readFailed: What the record says could not be read: fill the NCR by hand, or close and try again.
new.sitesFailed: The sites could not be read.
new.fieldTitleHint: In a few words (at most 160 characters).
new.suspectHint: More that may have the same problem.
new.defectsFailed: The defect library could not be read: the NCR can be made without a code.
new.zoneHint: The design's garment zone map: a zone of the garment, in words.
new.photosFrom_one: {count} photo of the record is shown on the NCR's source.
new.photosFrom_other: {count} photos of the record are shown on the NCR's source.
new.photosHeld: Adding photos needs the right to upload files (files.upload).
new.heldReading: The record is still being read.
new.heldRaise: Your role does not raise NCRs (quality.ncr.raise).
new.createdPhotosFailed: {number} is raised, but a photo was not added: add it on the NCR.
new.heldSeverity: Say how serious it is first.
new.defectsGone: A picked defect line is no longer on the inspection: open the inspection again and pick the lines.
new.containmentFailed: The containment time could not be read: the factory sets the due time when the NCR is created.

containmentTime.saved_other: Saved: new NCRs are due for containment {count} hours after the problem is found.
